chunks: From him, from Ṣafwān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about a man who performed the obligatory tawaf and did not perform the two rakʿahs until he had gone between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah, then he performed the tawaf of النساء and did not perform the two rakʿahs until he remembered while he was at al-Abṭaḥ, so he prayed four. He said: He should return and pray four at the Maqām.

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two units of prayer required after tawaf
key_terms.الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ: the two well-known places between which saʿy is performed
key_terms.الْأَبْطَحِ: the location where the person remembered the omitted prayer
key_terms.الْمَقَامِ: Maqām Ibrāhīm, the place where the tawaf prayer is to be performed
key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf whose completion affects marital permissibility in hajj rites
key_terms.طَوَافَ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory tawaf performed as a required rite

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he forgets the two rakʿahs of tawaf until after saʿy and tawaf al-nisāʾ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgot the two rakʿahs after both the obligatory tawaf and tawaf al-nisāʾ until leaving the immediate area. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام rules that he must return to the Maqām and perform four rakʿahs there, making up both omitted tawaf prayers.
